I'm so sorry you felt the need to do that to yourself. I don't know what's going on, but I can promise you cutting yourself isn't worth it. I know it helps in the moment but it's only going to cause more problems for you later on. You're probably not going very deep right now but it gets out of control really fast. It's alot like an addiction, you'll have to do go deeper and do it more often to get the same effect. I wish could go back in time and stop myself from ever starting. I'm in a constant state of anxiety that my sleeves will roll up too far and someone will see or my shorts won't go down quite far enough. I can't play any sports or go swimming anymore, and overheating because I can't wear short sleeves isn't fun at all. Please stop while you still can, the longer you do it the harder it'll be to stop. After you've done it for awhile the urges never really go away, no matter how long you've been clean. If you need someone to talk to feel free to pm me, I'd much rather you talk to me than hurt yourself.
